model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” illustrates how the maximum activation value varies by model layer for four series: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and uses a linear scale with integer layers spanning approximately 0 to 23, with major ticks shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” on a linear scale ranging from 0 up to about 1600, with ticks at regular 200-unit intervals. The attn_output line is blue with a dashed style and no markers; it stays near 0 across most layers and then rises late, reaching roughly ~250 by the final layer. The attn_residual line is orange with a dotted style and no markers; it is near 0 through about layer 4, jumps to around ~1400 at about layer 6, remains near ~1500–1600 through roughly layers 14–21, and then drops sharply near the end to roughly ~250 at the final layer. The ffn_output line is green with a dash-dot style and no markers; it is near 0 early, spikes to about ~1400 at around layer 5, falls back near 0 by around layers 7–12, spikes again to roughly ~700 around layer 13, returns to low values (tens) through about layers 14–21, and then spikes again near layer 22 to around ~1200 before ending around ~600 at the final layer. The ffn_residual line is red with a solid style and no markers; it is near 0 through about layer 4, jumps to about ~1400 at around layer 5, increases to roughly ~1500 by around layer 7, stays near ~1500 through about layer 12, rises to around ~1600 by about layers 14–21, then drops sharply near layer 22 to roughly ~400 and ends around ~600 at the final layer.

model_annotations.English: The plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” shows how the maximum activation value varies across model layers for four series (attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual). The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and uses a linear scale with integer layers spanning roughly 0 to 23, with major ticks shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at regular 200-unit intervals. The blue dashed line (attn_output) stays near 0 from layers 0 through about 21, then rises at the end to roughly 250 by layer 23. The orange dotted line (attn_residual) is near 0 through about layer 4, jumps to around 1400 at about layer 6, increases to about 1500–1600 by roughly layers 14–16, remains near ~1600 through about layer 21, and then drops sharply near the end to roughly 250 by layer 23. The green dash-dot line (ffn_output) is near 0 for most layers but shows sharp spikes: it rises to about 1400 at around layer 5, falls back near 0 by about layer 7, spikes again to roughly 700 around layer 13 before returning to low values, and then spikes again near layer 22 to around 1200 before dropping back down by layer 23. The red solid line (ffn_residual) is near 0 through about layer 4, jumps to about 1400 at around layer 5, increases to roughly 1500 by about layer 7, stays around 1500–1600 through about layer 21, then drops steeply to around 400 at about layer 22 and ends near roughly 600 at layer 23.
